fact: A study published in February 2026 reports that Moroccan addressing is partial, unmaintained or absent in many communes (especially small and medium ones), that decree 2-17-307 of 2018 requires a local address register per commune, and that postal workers and bailiffs find the absence or insufficiency of addressing the main obstacle to their work.
title: Effets de l'adressage sur les activités des facteurs postaux et des huissiers au Maroc
publisher: International Journal of Marketing and Strategic Management
